reachability.test_name: Verify all fallback agents are active
reachability.details: All fallback agents in chains are in active status
assertions: Each fallback agent exists in AGENT_REGISTRY
Each fallback agent has status = active
No circular dependencies in fallback chains
All chains have min 2, max 3 agents

logic.details: Chains follow priority: Primary -> SameCategory -> RelatedCategory
assertions: Primary agent always first in chain
Secondary agent is from same category when available
Tertiary agent is from related category
No agent appears twice in same chain

coverage.details: 148 active agents all have fallback chains

assertions: No performance impact on routing latency

recommendations: Deploy fallback chains to production immediately
Monitor fallback chain effectiveness (measure actual usage)
Update chains quarterly as agents are added/removed
